findings.description: AuthenticatedInvocationPort/Clock synthetic sentinel RuntimeException message leaks from reserve/activate/current/release; null Optional gives raw NPE. Null initial clock opens pool once although invalid clock must reject before pool.
findings.negativeAcceptance: All operation provider failures/null Optional/null initial instant normalize to generic no-cause IllegalStateException; Auth/Clock ingress errors open pool zero times.
findings.consumerBoundary: RuntimeOnlyStartupGuard normalizes freshness provider exceptions, so do not claim currently wired application leaked a real secret. Test sentinel values are synthetic.

findings.description: First current_database()/current_setting() query is unqualified before trusted search_path. Owned startup_shadow_fixture.current_database returns forged_startup_catalog while pg_catalog.current_database proves actual independent_startup_catalog. Expected wrong catalog authority reserve emitted signed lease instead of rejecting.
findings.negativeAcceptance: Native pg_catalog-qualified identity (or trusted normalization before inspection) rejects actual catalog mismatch; approved permit stays ISSUED and lease count remains zero.
findings.scopeBoundary: Full trusted endpoint/native control-catalog ownership/approved exact ACL policy is still OPEN beyond this single spoof case.

findings.description: reserve@t0, activate@t2, current@t1 all within permit window emitted a future-issued signed ACTIVE lease. Per-call entered/now equality does not detect native persisted issued_at regression across calls.
findings.negativeAcceptance: Reject now earlier than persisted lease issuedAt without renewal or mutation; retain existing consumed phase/native single lease.
findings.consumerBoundary: RuntimeOnlyStartupGuard rejects future-issued lease, so this is producer fail-closed/current-state integrity rather than a proved application privilege escalation.

findings.description: Approved immutable native Control schema, principal attributes/membership/ownership, exact column/table/PUBLIC/default/routine/TEMP ACL baseline and independent endpoint/server/catalog binding have no verifier in candidate; name-only identity is not full native authority approval.

Invocation transport remains explicit fixture. Candidate is unregistered/unwired: ControlMain-native offline fencing, real permit/seal publication, authority transport, current 13-stream bootstrap, key lifecycle approval and continuous readiness renewal/drain remain OPEN.

findings.sourceSymbol: reserveLease/activateLease Java Instant → native timestamptz → sign before/readback after
findings.description: The first reserve/activate signs full-nanosecond Java values whereas retry/current signs PostgreSQL microsecond stored values. PostgreSQL .123456789 rounds to .123457 (211ns future); .987654321 normalizes to .987654. Identical native lease IDs produce different signed canonical documents.
findings.negativeAcceptance: Explicit native precision floor before storage, without future round-up/lease expansion; claims come from canonical native row; reserve retry and active current return identical document for unchanged row. Keep raw monotonic clock checks separately from native storage precision.
